authority: Primary explicitly approved exact rubric and comparison bounds before final scores; supplements a0-freeze.json without changing its floors.

model.stop: First complete strictly typed four-field JSON object: answer,citations,need_more,query

followups: All conditions retain legitimate followups within residual equal budgets. Query defaults to canonical search; READ rN expands around the verified location of an actually returned record, never an agent-supplied filename. No gold-derived scope; QASPER original publisher-paper scope and global Hotpot collection unchanged.

grader.normalization: Lowercase, remove ASCII punctuation and English articles a/an/the, normalize whitespace
grader.extractive_spans: Join original spans in original order
grader.completion: Answer threshold and complete actually returned plus valid cited original support from SAME human alternative

reporting: Report all-task outcomes/failures/turns and paired common-success turn comparison; original dataset/question categories and disagreements; source/citation precision; all internal calls, Arbiter compute, preprocessing, external inference and total wall time separately. Source-document connected components are descriptive bootstrap dependency groups only, never gold evidence unions.
next_read_projection: Primary approved mechanically projected usefulness when an actual verified legal read adds a missing original human support fact within an original alternative. This is not a human annotation of AIRK action authority, sufficiency or gap; native authorization remains independent.
status: Frozen evaluation design; no final model scores, quality pass or production promotion implied
